name: StoryCore Harbour
tagline: Turn an idea into a coherent, production-ready visual story.
description:
StoryCore Harbour transforms a concept, synopsis, or short script into a structured production package inside Anna. It produces a production bible, visual direction, characters, locations, scenes, shots, reusable generation prompts, and a continuity report, then saves and exports the validated project.

**Core workflow**

- Describe the project and choose its format, duration, language, tone, and audience.
- Build a coherent world with stable character and location identities.
- Review an ordered scene and shot plan.
- Save the project and export StoryCore-compatible JSON.

The core workflow does not require a local GPU, ComfyUI, Blender, or a separate API key.
